aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab develops practical software for food trucks and mobile sellers. It delivers online orders, collection-time management and fewer repeated enquiries. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About the company — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We develop practical software specialised for food trucks and mobile sellers. It supports taking online orders, managing collection times and keeping orders flowing smoothly, and reduces time spent answering repeated enquiries.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was born to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available is made on the assumption of shops with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: to make running a food truck easier with tools matched to how food trucks actually trade.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began from one simple realisation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After launching Village Foodie, a directory for finding food trucks coming to your area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are always moving, trade in various places and serve customers in ever-changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Before the trading date, customers can order for a future date and time.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Analyse sales by period, item and trading date to see what is really selling.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically, so there's no need to approve each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: You can put your logo in the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Register a buzzer number to the order when you hand a buzzer out, and you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see shows order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab's public map so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming trading dates on your own website. Each date goes straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with their own prices and settings, for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The way to get the most out of HatchGrab. Besides a real-time kitchen display, it is the only means of continuing to take orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much can be cooked at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer pick it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards. Both giving stamps and redeeming rewards are automatic.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into sets or suggest extra items at ordering to raise the average spend per customer.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries too.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Show the same orders in real time on several screens, such as the front counter and the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Issue each staff member a login with the appropriate permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you turn on offline order protection, taking online orders pauses automatically when the signal drops, so no orders you can’t see come in.
featuresPage.offlineApps: With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you can keep taking orders offline. The web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, you can take card payment upfront via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an order cut-off time for items that take time to prepare.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don't show on the map, and issue a dedicated ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and order page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your trading schedule automatically from your website or the images you usually post to Facebook. Just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically notify customers by SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Just upload your designs and we automatically insert the dates, places and times for each week and each trading date.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Make an item sold out in one tap. It greys out on customers' screens straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count and it goes down with each order, then automatically sells out when it runs out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Accept card payments on a supported smartphone, so you don't need to prepare a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so orders are spread across your trading hours.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the counter. Payment is taken on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your trading from a smartphone, tablet or computer browser.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically reply to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and trading schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long cooking takes. Once a collection time slot is full, customers can no longer choose that time.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the smartphone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle, and the card terminal you always use.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, stable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But food trucks trade in a different place each week, at different times, sometimes where the signal is weak or absent. HatchGrab was made for that way of trading.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you turn on offline order protection, taking online orders pauses automatically when the signal drops, so no orders you can’t see come in.
landing.does.offlineApps: Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you always post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in dates, places and times automatically, ready to share right away. Weekly or daily.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Queues shrink, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.slotsTitle: Customers can choose a collection time
landing.does.title: For food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: "Where are you trading tonight?" "What desserts do you have?" Even while driving to the site or cooking, WhatsApp messages are answered automatically based on your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram support coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: "Where are you trading tonight?" "What desserts do you have?" Soon WhatsApp messages will be answered automatically even while driving to the site or cooking. Messenger and Instagram to follow.
landing.final.lede: Just upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and within 60 seconds we make an order page you can actually try. Your items and prices as they are. No registration, no card, no installation. Look first, then decide.
landing.final.title: Want to try how easy setup is?
